news.title: A $1.3 billion event is coming to Australia. And ‘nobody is ready’
news.lede: “This thing’s gonna be massive, and I just don’t think everyone’s ready, or aware, that it’s coming – and it’s coming in a year,” says David MacCallum, in charge of premium experiences for the Men’s Rugby World Cup Australia 2027. And he’s not just talking about the prodigious drinking habits of rugby fans. The other stereotypes are also true. Rugby fans spend more, do more business networking, and are a little more friendly to the opposition than other football codes, says MacCallum.

news.title: FA to canvass England players in World Cup review
news.lede: England's men have not won a major tournament since the 1996 World Cup. The Football Association's review into England's World Cup campaign will canvass the opinions of players involved in the tournament. English football's governing body has started the post-tournament review they conduct after every major international competition. The FA says the review is the standard process it undertakes after all tournaments.

news.title: The best do not always win the World Cup: Cafu | Football News
news.lede: Mumbai: On a stage at a college atrium, Cafu soaked in the adulation. Students, brandishing any Brazilian jersey they could find – from the present selection with ‘Neymar Jr’ printed on the back to quite a few with ‘Ronaldo’ – cheered him on. Cafu beckoned a few to toss their shirts forward for him to sign and send back.And then his eye caught a replica World Cup trophy. More silver than gold, it was handed over to him to pose with.

news.title: India Vs Panama Football Friendly Date Changed Due To Marathon
news.lede: Discover why India's highly anticipated international football friendly against 2026 World Cup participant Panama in Bengaluru has been rescheduled to September 25, offering a crucial test for the Blue Tigers. India's international football friendly against Panama here has been advanced by a day from the scheduled September 26 as the Sree Kanteerava Stadium, the venue of the match, will host the Bengaluru Marathon on September 27. Since the Kanteerava Stadium will serve as the starting and finishing point of the marathon race, it will be difficult to host the India vs Panama football match the next day as per the earlier schedule, according to sources. The match will now be held on September 25.
